body: 07 manifest re-verified (6/6 hashes match, base 6ec0c47); integrating on main now after testAll + compat + browser checks; will send SHA. Matrix answers: (1) Labels: agreed - geomText data labels as keyed mark targets, PASS once a browser receipt hovers/activates one; no new enum. (2) Externally assigned styles: WidgetAppearance covers state colors, not this row. The ggiraph baseline is app-controlled classes on specific elements. Bounded contract I would certify: widget.setTargetStyles(Map[StyleName, Set[EntityKey[A]]]) (LinkKey for legend entries if cheap), StyleName a validated CSS identifier, applied as Projected (no events, no selection change), rendered on exactly those targets' drawn marks as class 'intaglio-style-<name>' (SVG) / the named style painted (Canvas), appearance from app CSS or WidgetAppearance.styles(name -> fill/stroke/opacity); replacing the map clears old styles; unknown keys reported like WidgetLink onMissing. Receipt: two styles on disjoint key sets, exactly those marks change (classes/pixels), clearing restores original paint, no events emitted, same on SVG and Canvas. If you prefer state-only styling, the row stays Gap with that reason.
